$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: IN SYNC as of introspect-wasm@0.71.13 (core@c6f329e, tag v0.71.13). Its catalog change: host functions 161 -> 166 and operations 130 -> 135 (ADR 163 insertFootnote, deleteFootnote; ADR 164 editHyperlink, deleteHyperlink; ADR 165 updateTableOfContents); property schemas 433 -> 445, the twelve document footnote options on the doc address (ADR 162). Settable paths stay 241. The wire also gains the read-only, unadvertised tableHeaderRowCount / tableFooterRowCount (no catalog row, like tableRowCount) and the committed-change fields of ADR 159 (gestureCommitted.reflow, scriptResult.writes / pageIds, PageSummary.pageOrigin / spreadId). No protocol change (71). Prior: in sync as of introspect-wasm@0.71.12 (core@ee5d9bf).
